unitTitle: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If

pairsWith.noteUz: 1-tur shart gap, when/if mashqlari va 1-5-unitlar takrori (Revision).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 5-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET (28-bet, PDF 27). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '5'.

CHAP USTUN:
9-mashq davomi: 7 You ...... (burn) yourself if you ...... (not/be) careful. 8 If Debbie ...... (not/finish) late, she ...... (do) the shopping. 9 When Ann ...... (graduate), she ...... (travel) abroad. 10 I ...... (buy) you a magazine when I ...... (come) home from work.
10) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.' 1 A: Is Jack having dinner with us tonight? B: If he ...... (come) home early, he ...... (have) dinner with us. 2 A: I don't think Tom is going on holiday this summer. B: If he ...... (save) some money, he ...... (be/able) to go on holiday. 3 A: I must leave for the airport. B: If you ...... (not/leave) right away, you ...... (miss) your flight. 4 A: Monica should call Gary. B: If she ...... (not/call) him, he ...... (be) very upset. 5 A: Do you know where Fay's Restaurant is? B: Yes. If you ...... (turn) left at the traffic lights, you ...... (see) it on your right next to the chemist's. 6 A: I want to go to the park. B: If you ...... (behave) yourself today, I ...... (take) you to the park tomorrow.
11) 'Use the pictures and the prompts below to make sentences about what each person will do if they win the lottery, as in the example.' RASM: o'rtada 'win the lottery' (pul qozon), atrofida: a David/buy a castle (qal'a); b Michael/donate money to charity (pul uzatilgan qo'llar); c Andrew/have his own restaurant (oshpaz); d Helen/open own toy shop (o'yinchoqlar); e Vanessa/move to Beverly Hills (Kaliforniya xaritasi); f Laura/travel to the Caribbean (plyaj). a If David wins the lottery, he will buy a castle. b-f ......

O'NG USTUN - 'When - if':
12) 'Fill in the gaps with if or when and the correct form of the verbs in brackets.' 1 ...... you get to the end of the street, you ...... (see) a bank. 2 ...... he works hard, he ...... (become) successful. 3 ...... I don't study, I ...... (not/pass) the exam tomorrow. 4 ...... Amanda graduates, she ...... (start) looking for a job. 5 I ...... (call) my doctor tomorrow, ...... I don't feel well. 6 ...... I get to the office, I ...... (send) a fax. 7 ...... I am 18, my father ...... (buy) me a car. 8 I ...... (tell) Karen to give you a ring ...... she wakes up. 9 ...... Jim ...... (not/arrive) on time they will leave without him. 10 You ...... (catch) a cold ...... you don't wear your coat.
'Revision: Units 1 - 5':
13) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 What's she job? → her 2 What do you does in your free time? 3 Next year we do travelling to Canada. 4 A: I often watch TV in the evenings. B: Nor do I. 5 Is Brussels really the good place for shoppers? 6 It was nine o'clock at night and Dennis studied. 7 Does John use to have a pet? 8 This must be the bad hotel in the world.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '28'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or future simple (continued).
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki future simple shaklida qo'ying (davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAP - DAVOMI.

  Bosh gap oldin, if/when keyin
  kelishi ham mumkin (vergul yo'q):
  7 You WILL BURN yourself if you
    AREN'T careful.
  8 If Debbie DOESN'T FINISH late,
    she WILL DO the shopping.
  9 When Ann GRADUATES, she WILL
    TRAVEL abroad.
  10 I WILL BUY you a magazine
     when I COME home.


⚠ 'TO GRADUATE':

  = (o'quv yurtini) bitirmoq.

items.textEn: You ___ (burn) yourself if you ___ (not/be) careful.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Bosh gap will; if qismida aren't.

items.textEn: If Debbie ___ (not/finish) late, she ___ (do) the shopping.
items.whyUz: ⚠ If Debbie doesn't finish, she will do.

items.textEn: When Ann ___ (graduate), she ___ (travel) abroad.
items.whyUz: ⚠ When Ann graduates (-s), she will travel.

items.textEn: I ___ (buy) you a magazine when I ___ (come) home from work.
items.whyUz: ⚠ I will buy ... when I come.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOGLARDA 1-TUR ShART GAP.

  1 If he COMES, he WILL HAVE
  2 If he SAVES, he WILL BE ABLE
  3 If you DON'T LEAVE, you WILL
    MISS
  4 If she DOESN'T CALL, he WILL
    BE
  5 If you TURN, you WILL SEE
  6 If you BEHAVE, I WILL TAKE


⚠ 'TO BE ABLE TO':

  = ... qila olmoq (can ning
  kelajagi: will be able to).


⚠ 'RIGHT AWAY':

  = darhol.


⚠ 'TO BEHAVE YOURSELF':

  = o'zini yaxshi tutmoq.


⚠ 'THE CHEMIST'S':

  = dorixona.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures and the prompts below to make sentences about what each person will do if they win the lottery, as in the example. a David/buy a castle; b Michael/donate money to charity; c Andrew/have his own restaurant; d Helen/open own toy shop; e Vanessa/move to Beverly Hills; f Laura/travel to the Caribbean.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar va ko'rsatmalar bilan har bir kishi lotereya yutsa nima qilishi haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. a Devid/qal'a sotib olish; b Maykl/xayriyaga pul berish; c Endryu/o'z restoraniga ega bo'lish; d Helen/o'z o'yinchoq do'konini ochish; e Vanessa/Beverli-Hillzga ko'chish; f Laura/Karib dengiziga sayohat.
exercises.explanationUz:
IF + KIM + WINS the lottery, KIM
  + WILL + fe'l.

  ⚠ 'wins' - 3-shaxs -s.
  ⚠ 'his own / her own' = o'zining.


⚠ 'TO WIN THE LOTTERY':

  = lotereya yutmoq.


⚠ 'TO DONATE':

  = xayriya qilmoq.


⚠ 'BEVERLY HILLS':

  = Los-Anjelesdagi boylar mahallasi.

exercises.exampleUz: a Agar Devid lotereya yutsa, qal'a sotib oladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with if or when and the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni if yoki when va qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
WHEN (albatta bo'ladi) yoki IF
  (balki)?

  1 WHEN you get to the end (albatta
    yetasiz) - will see
  2 IF he works hard (balki) - will
    become
  3 IF I don't study - won't pass
  4 WHEN Amanda graduates (albatta)
    - will start
  5 will call ... IF I don't feel
    well
  6 WHEN I get to the office
    (albatta) - will send
  7 WHEN I am 18 (albatta bo'laman)
    - will buy
  8 will tell ... WHEN she wakes up
    (albatta uyg'onadi)
  9 IF Jim doesn't arrive (balki)
  10 will catch ... IF you don't
     wear


⚠ 'TO GIVE SOMEONE A RING':

  = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SEND A FAX':

  = faks yubormoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: What's she job? → her
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni tuzating, namunadagidek. Namuna: What's she job? → her
exercises.explanationUz:
1-5-UNITLAR XATOLARI.

  1 she → HER (egalik) - NAMUNA
  2 does → DO (do you do)
  3 do travelling → ARE travelling
    (kelishuv)
  4 Nor do I → SO do I (tasdiqqa
    qo'shilish)
  5 the good → THE BEST (orttirma
    - 'really the best place')
  6 studied → WAS STUDYING (soat
    9 da - davom)
  7 Does → DID John use to
  8 the bad → THE WORST


⚠ 'BRUSSELS':

  = Bryussel (Belgiya poytaxti).

patterns.formula: If + KIM + wins the lottery, KIM + will + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If David wins the lottery, he will buy a castle.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar Devid lotereya yutsa, qal'a sotib oladi.

patterns.formula: KIM + will + FE'L + if + KIM + don't/doesn't + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: You will catch a cold if you don't wear your coat.

patterns.formula: When + KIM + FE'L(s), KIM + will + FE'L (albatta)
patterns.exampleEn: When I am 18, my father will buy me a car.
patterns.exampleUz: 18 ga to'lganimda otam menga mashina sotib beradi.
